product_offering.core_offering: Labelbox provides an AI data factory and reinforcement learning (RL) data engine for AI teams, offering annotation tools, APIs, and expert networks to generate high-quality training data for machine learning models. Its product suite includes Horizon (RL environments and preference signals), Terra (robotics data products), Alignerr (network of 2.6M+ knowledge experts), and Recursion (RL platform for enterprise specialist agents). The platform supports multimodal data annotation across text, image, video, audio, and documents.
product_offering.differentiator: Labelbox differentiates through its RL data engine approach combining Horizon (RL environments), Terra (robotics data), Alignerr (expert network of 2.6M+ experts), and Recursion (enterprise agent RL platform). The company has proprietary research capabilities including AI safety evaluation frameworks and agent evaluation methodologies. Their Multimodal Chat Solution supports text, images, video, audio, and documents.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Provides complete RL data infrastructure for AI teams including RL environments and preference signals for post training, full-stack robotics data products, expert human grounding signals, and enterprise agent development platforms. Enables evaluation of frontier AI reasoning, automated expert recruitment, and scalable training data generation.
product_offering.problem_solved: Labelbox solves the critical bottleneck in AI development: obtaining high-quality, differentiated training data from domain experts at scale. The company addresses the challenge of engaging elite domain experts efficiently, providing RL environments and evaluation infrastructure, and enabling enterprises to build specialist AI agents that improve from real execution.
quantifiable_outcome: Meta released GIM-615 benchmark with 820 expert-authored problems remaining far from saturated with ~20% of items above frontier ability
RL systems outperformed sparse rewards by 300% when using rubric-based rewards and GRPO on real-world e-commerce tasks
product_offering.product_overview: Labelbox is an AI data factory and RL (reinforcement learning) data engine for AI teams. The company offers a platform-plus-products architecture serving both frontier AI labs and enterprises. For frontier AI, the core offerings include Horizon (RL environments and preference signals), Terra (full stack data for robotics foundation models), and Alignerr (expert network of 2.6M+ knowledge experts). For enterprises, Recursion is the RL platform for building, evaluating, and deploying specialist AI agents on real enterprise workflows. Additional products include Labelbox Applied Research (with Labelbox Evals, Labelbox Agents, and Labelbox Robotics), various leaderboards and benchmarks (Deep Research, Complex Reasoning, EchoChain, R-ConstraintBench), and research frameworks (Implicit Intelligence, Agent-as-a-World, Intent Laundering). The platform supports multimodal data processing across text, images, video, audio, and documents, with Python SDK and MCP support for automation.

recent_move.description: Acquired Upcraft, an AI-powered sales automation startup, to integrate AI agent technology into the Alignerr expert network and automate expert recruitment and engagement workflows.
Launched Recursion, an RL platform for building, evaluating, and continuously improving specialist AI agents on real enterprise workflows at a fraction of frontier AI token costs.
Launched Labelbox Applied Research with three product pillars — Labelbox Evals, Labelbox Agents, and Labelbox Robotics (LBRx) — formalizing a research-led product suite.
Raised $110 million Series D led by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 at over $1 billion valuation, achieving unicorn status and capital to scale RL data infrastructure and global expansion.
Launched Labelbox Evaluation Studio, a private, real-time evaluation platform for top AI teams to unlock tailored insights on model strengths and weaknesses.
Co-developed the GIM benchmark with Meta, producing 820 expert-authored problems across seven cognitive categories calibrated over 200,000+ prompt-response pairs to evaluate frontier AI reasoning.

expansion_highlight.description: Launch of Terra (robotics foundation model data) and Labelbox Robotics (LBRx) in November 2025 expands Labelbox from text/image labeling into physical-world robotics data, opening a new vertical adjacent to its core AI data business.

Launch of Recursion (June 2026) creates an enterprise specialist-agent RL platform, expanding Labelbox from data labeling tooling to full-stack enterprise agent training and serving, addressing a much larger enterprise AI TAM.

Acquisition of Upcraft (February 2026) brings AI agent technology into the Alignerr expert-recruitment workflow, indicating an active inorganic expansion strategy to deepen automation of the expert supply chain.

Partnerships with Google Cloud (Vertex AI integration) and Intuitive Surgical (surgical robotics) extend Labelbox's customer base beyond frontier AI labs into hyperscaler platforms and regulated healthcare/robotics enterprises.

Continuous release of benchmarks and research artifacts (EchoChain audio reasoning, Implicit Intelligence, Agent-as-a-World, Intent Laundering, Deep Research Leaderboard, Complex Reasoning Leaderboard, R-ConstraintBench) builds an external research brand that funnels developer and lab attention back into the platform.

Recursion's "fraction of frontier AI token costs" positioning implies a usage- or outcome-based pricing model for enterprise RL training, departing from per-seat labeling subscriptions and broadening commercial surface area.

company_assessment.market_position: Labelbox is a private, venture-backed company founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company has achieved unicorn status (> $1 billion valuation) following a $110 million Series D round led by SoftBank's Vision Fund 2 in January 2022. Labelbox serves over 200 enterprise customers and partners with over 90% of leading AI labs in the U.S., positioning itself as the leading RL data engine for AI teams. The company has 101-250 employees and serves both frontier AI labs and large enterprises with multiple AI use cases across industries including AI research, cloud computing, healthcare/robotics, and retail/ecommerce.

strengths.details: As frontier model development shifts from pre-training to RLHF and post-training, Labelbox's Alignerr (2.6M+ experts) and Horizon (RL environments) are positioned to capture disproportionate spend — Meta's GIM benchmark (820 expert-authored problems, 200K+ prompt-response pairs) demonstrates the company can deliver differentiated expert-curated RL data at frontier scale.
strengths.headline: Pivots into RL data engine for post-training boom

strengths.details: A 2.6M+ vetted expert network takes years to assemble and cannot be replicated by software-only rivals. As more enterprises and labs require human grounding signals (rubrics, preferences, expert reasoning), this asset compounds — each engagement enriches the network's domain coverage and ability to staff new verticals faster than competitors.
strengths.headline: Alignerr expert network becomes defensible data moat

strengths.details: Recursion (launched June 2026) targets the enterprise specialist-agent market at 'a fraction of frontier AI token costs.' If enterprise RL adoption accelerates, Labelbox can monetize its Alignerr network and RL infrastructure on a far larger customer base than frontier labs alone — converting research positioning into recurring enterprise SaaS revenue.
strengths.headline: Recursion opens enterprise agent RL market

strengths.details: Terra delivers purpose-built hardware-collected video and trajectory data for robotics foundation models — an emerging category where training data scarcity is a known bottleneck. Early positioning with proprietary collection hardware and AI-powered diversity engines positions Labelbox to capture share if robotics foundation models follow LLM-style scaling trajectories.
strengths.headline: Robotics foundation model opportunity via Terra

strengths.details: With over 90% of leading U.S. AI labs already partnered, Labelbox has minimal customer acquisition friction for new product launches — Horizon, Recursion, and applied research can be sold into an existing relationship base, accelerating revenue ramp relative to greenfield peers.
strengths.headline: Land-and-expand with 90%+ U.S. AI lab penetration

weakness.details: Scale AI's ~35% market share gives it structural advantages in pricing, government/defense relationships, and customer lock-in. As Scale expands into RL and evaluation, Labelbox could face share erosion and pricing pressure that compresses unit economics across its core labeling business.
weakness.headline: Scale AI dominance compresses pricing and share

weakness.details: Frontier AI labs (Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) have the engineering depth and capital to internalize RL data infrastructure. If even one major lab shifts expert sourcing and RL environments in-house, Labelbox would lose a flagship reference customer and demonstrate reduced strategic defensibility to remaining prospects.
weakness.headline: Frontier AI labs may build RL data infrastructure in-house

weakness.details: Recursion enters a market where incumbents (Scale, Surge, Snorkel) and hyperscalers (Vertex AI Agent Builder, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock Agents) are all racing to own enterprise agent tooling. If the category fails to consolidate around specialist RL platforms, Labelbox's enterprise expansion could stall and dilute R&D impact across products.
weakness.headline: Enterprise agent RL market is nascent and crowded

weakness.details: With ~$188.9M raised total and a 2022 last round, supporting Horizon, Terra, Alignerr, Recursion, plus applied research labs and recent acquisition (Upcraft, Feb 2026) at 101–250 employees strains capital. If revenue growth lags the 2022–2026 AI capex surge, runway may force prioritization that weakens one or more product lines.
weakness.headline: Capital efficiency concern given breadth of product bets

weakness.details: Managing annotation and rubric quality across a 2.6M+ contributor network (Alignerr) is operationally complex; a single publicized quality incident on a frontier AI benchmark (e.g., contaminated data, faulty rubrics) could damage the credibility that underpins premium pricing versus software-only competitors.
weakness.headline: Expert network quality is hard to police at 2.6M+ scale

competitive_moat.details: Alignerr network of 2.6M+ knowledge experts (some sources cite 1M+ domain experts) provides differentiated, human-generated training signal that frontier AI models cannot self-generate. This human expert pool is the core asset underlying Horizon RL environments, Terra robotics data, and Recursion enterprise agent training.

Partnerships with over 90% of leading AI labs in the U.S. create compounding network effects where lab adoption drives expert engagement, benchmark legitimacy, and further lab adoption. Named enterprise partnerships with Meta, Google Cloud (Vertex AI integration), and Intuitive Surgical reinforce this gravity.

Proprietary research artifacts (Intent Laundering framework, Agent-as-a-World, Implicit Intelligence, EchoChain, R-ConstraintBench, Deep Research Leaderboard) plus benchmarks such as GIM with Meta create reputation and methodological IP that competitors must replicate from scratch.

Native IAM-delegated integrations with AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, and Azure Blob Storage plus Python SDK and MCP support embed Labelbox into enterprise data pipelines and AI agent workflows, raising migration costs once training data, rubrics, and RL environments are operationalized.

An applied research team producing peer-reviewed-style work (NeurIPS 2025 participation, arXiv publications) and a named executive bench (CEO Manu Sharma, plus acquired Upcraft co-founder Greg Caplan) supports the credibility required to win frontier-lab engagements.

Enterprise customers investing in custom rubrics, RL environments, and Alignerr-managed expert pools face operational switching costs: re-platforming annotation workflows, re-validating expert-screened datasets, and re-running evaluation harnesses against internal benchmarks.

key_risks.details: Scale AI holds approximately 35% of the dedicated AI data labeling market, dwarfing Labelbox's share and giving Scale significant advantages in customer relationships, pricing power, and government/defense contracts.
key_risks.headline: Scale AI holds 35% market share as dominant incumbent

key_risks.details: Disclosed marquee customers are concentrated among a handful of frontier labs and large enterprises (Meta, Google Cloud, Intuitive Surgical). With 200+ customers but reliance on AI labs for the Alignerr volume, a slowdown at one or two top labs would meaningfully impact utilization.
key_risks.headline: Customer concentration risk on a small set of frontier AI labs

key_risks.details: Series D closed at a $1B+ valuation in January 2022. With no subsequent disclosed round in the source data and an undisclosed revenue/ARR figure, the gap between the last mark and current fundamentals (4+ years later) is material for any diligence conclusion.
key_risks.headline: Last priced round was January 2022 — no fresh signal on current valuation or runway

key_risks.details: Labelbox operates at least four major product lines (Horizon, Terra, Alignerr, Recursion) plus several research frameworks and benchmarks. Spreading 101–250 employees across frontier AI data, robotics data, enterprise agents, and applied research raises execution risk versus focused competitors.
key_risks.headline: Product portfolio breadth may strain execution

key_risks.details: Labelbox acquired Upcraft in February 2026 to integrate AI agent technology into Alignerr. Recent acquisitions in fast-moving AI markets frequently under-deliver on integration synergies, and the acquisition adds another product surface area.
key_risks.headline: Acquisition integration risk from Upcraft

key_risks.details: Operating geographies are listed primarily as San Francisco Bay Area and broader North America, with no documented international expansion outside U.S.-led AI labs — limiting exposure to growing AI ecosystems in Europe and Asia.
key_risks.headline: Geographic concentration in U.S. limits diversification

key_highlights.details: Labelbox raised $110M in Series D funding led by SoftBank's Vision Fund II in January 2022, achieving a post-money valuation of over $1 billion, with cumulative funding of approximately $188.9M across five rounds.
key_highlights.headline: Unicorn valuation backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 Series D

key_highlights.details: Alignerr brings together 2.6M+ knowledge experts who provide real-world grounding signals and human expertise for training frontier AI models — a scale that few competitors can match.
key_highlights.headline: Massive 2.6M+ expert network (Alignerr) creates unique data moat

key_highlights.details: Labelbox partners with over 90% of leading AI labs in the U.S., providing strong network effects and a defensible position in frontier AI development infrastructure.
key_highlights.headline: Penetration with 90%+ of leading U.S. AI labs

key_highlights.details: Named customers include Meta (GIM benchmark with 820 expert-authored problems), Google Cloud (human preference signal inside Vertex AI), and Intuitive Surgical (robotic surgery video annotation).
key_highlights.headline: Marquee enterprise customers including Meta and Google Cloud

key_highlights.details: Proprietary products Horizon (RL environments), Terra (robotics data), Alignerr (expert network), and Recursion (enterprise agent RL) span pre-training, post-training, and evaluation. Research IP includes Intent Laundering, Agent-as-a-World, and Implicit Intelligence frameworks.
key_highlights.headline: Full-stack RL data engine with proprietary research IP

key_highlights.details: Labelbox maintains SOC2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certifications — enabling healthcare (Intuitive Surgical) and other regulated use cases.
key_highlights.headline: Enterprise-grade compliance posture unblocks regulated workloads

key_highlights.details: Major launches in 2024–2026 include Multimodal Chat Solution, MCP support, Integrated VS Code IDE, Labelbox Evaluation Studio, EchoChain, Labelbox Applied Research, and Recursion — signaling sustained R&D investment.
key_highlights.headline: Continuous product velocity across applied research and platform

customer_concentration.details: Labelbox's named customer base combines a few marquee logos (Meta, Google Cloud, Intuitive Surgical) with a broader base of 200+ enterprise customers reported at Series D. The mix of frontier AI labs and large enterprises with multiple AI use cases suggests a moderate top-of-book concentration rather than a critical single-customer dependency. However, named marquee relationships like Meta GIM and Vertex AI integration imply non-trivial revenue contribution from a small number of large accounts. Pricing is hybrid (freemium self-serve plus quote-based enterprise), which diversifies the long tail. Overall concentration risk is Moderate, with churn exposure concentrated in the largest frontier-lab accounts where switching costs are also highest.
